parsed.name: Keysight N77xx 可调谐激光源模块
parsed.name_en: Keysight N77xx tunable laser source module
parsed.description: 用于光通信与光子学测试的可调谐激光源模块，可在设定波长范围内输出稳定激光，并支持步进或连续扫波测量，常用于插损、滤波器与器件光谱响应表征。
parsed.description_en: A tunable laser source module for photonics and optical communications testing. It provides stable output over a selectable wavelength range and supports step or continuous wavelength sweeps for insertion-loss, filter, and spectral-response characterization.
